title: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING illustrators and comic art roles
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Open until all positions are filled.

author: willai3213
title: Seeking graphic designer for exhibition visual and character design
